newsitem.title: USA: UST unit launches marketing, sales plan.
newsitem.headline: UST unit launches marketing, sales plan.

text.p: UST Inc said that its subsidiary, United States Tobacco Co, has debuted a series of new marketing and sales initiatives intended to help address the competitive situation in the marketplace.
These initiatives include the introduction of its Red Seal, a new value brand of smokeless tobacco.
The unit is launching two special quarterly promotions in 1997 featuring Copenhagen and Skoal, and it is offering Wintergreen in four-can value packs.
The company has begun an advertising and marketing campaign focusing on Copenhagen's "made-date," which offers consumers an indication of the freshness of the product.

"U.S. Tobacco's innovative promotions for our premium product lines, coupled with the strengthening of our sales operations and trade relationships, should serve notice to our stakeholders that we intend to continue to be the standard by which this industry is judged," UST Chairman and Chief Executive Vincent Gierer said in a statement.

"In addition, the introduction of Red Seal strikes to the heart of our current competitive situation in the marketplace by offering adult consumers of moist smokeless tobacco products a new product option in the price value category," he said.
